name: Dismantlable-Ample Characterization Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary family and its one-inclusion graph.
statement: Ample-prefix orders, prefix-isometric orders, reverse corner-peeling orders, acyclic unique-sink orientations, and zero ordering width define the same class.
proof: For an isometric family, the first four order and orientation formulations are equivalent by the corner-peeling correspondence. An order has width zero precisely when every minimal predecessor disagreement is a singleton; the linear-quotients and Alexander-dual shelling dictionary identifies these orders with the same ample-prefix orders.
